objective: Stop spending research capacity on dead opportunities early, preserving everything. (1) server/services/cash/retirement.ts exports a pure deadThesis(opportunity, facts, needsAssessment, signal) returning null or one reason from a closed set: NO_PAYER (both bounded deep dives spent, MAX_VALIDATION_ROUNDS, and every capture-input need's research finished NO_SUPPORT), NO_ACCESS (access need researched to NO_SUPPORT twice), INELIGIBLE (an EVIDENCE eligibility or disqualifier fact whose gated claim was declared by the worker as establishing ineligibility — add a closed `eligibility_verdict` declaration on brain_submit_claims, validated at both submission doors like opportunity_signal; never read from prose), NEGATIVE_MARGIN (proposed economics term negative from published figures only), FULFILMENT_UNAVAILABLE (a capability MISSING with no integration path), PROHIBITED (the only route needs an ALWAYS_PROHIBITED_COMMERCIAL action). An unknown never kills: every reason requires positive rows. (2) Derived, not stored: reconcileDiscoverableGaps, startValidations (via whyNotDiving: new DiveRefusal kind THESIS_DEAD) and the monetization commissioning allocator skip a dead piece; no state column moves and nothing is archived or deleted. (3) A CASH_THESIS_RETIRED event is appended once per (opportunity, reason) so the history says when spending stopped and why; if the rows change so the reason no longer holds the piece is live again with no write. (4) tests/cashRetirement.test.ts: each reason from rows; an unknown never retires; a retired piece raises no need, no dive, no commission across ten ticks; evidence and claims are unchanged; reversal on new evidence.
expectedOutcome: Research capacity flows to live opportunities; dead theses are visible with their reason and never re-researched forever.
nonGoals: A second opportunity pipeline, queue, scheduler or polling loop beside the durable Russell tick and operate()
Changing the evidence gate, verification, audit roles or approval envelopes
A full-table read on every tick; every new read is narrow, indexed and bounded

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/cashRetirement.test.ts passes on SQLite and Postgres
whyNotDiving and refinement-report print THESIS_DEAD with the reason

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commits; any migration only adds columns with defaults or a nullable column.
